review_candidates.title: SCADA Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are searching a SCADA Software Engineer to join a team responsible for a business-critical 24/7 SCADA platform supporting real-time power balancing activities across multiple European countries. The role focuses on the development, maintenance, and evolution of industrial real-time systems used for power generation monitoring, grid balancing, and flexibility asset integration. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering capabilities with an industrial mindset, understands operational constraints of critical systems, and is comfortable working in a high-availability environment requiring stability, resilience, and occasional operational support. Your missions: Develop and maintain a real-time industrial SCADA platform used for power balancing operations. Contribute to both backend and frontend development activities. Build scalable, robust, and maintainable software solutions. Support integration of flexibility assets and real-time operational requirements. Participate in Agile/SAFe delivery activities alongside analysts, dispatchers, architects, and technical teams. Ensure system reliability, availability, and operational continuity for business-critical applications. Contribute to on-call support after onboarding. Support industrial cybersecurity compliance requirements within ICS/OT environments. Contribute to the continuous improvement of development practices, architecture, and operational processes. Your activities: Develop and maintain applications based on MicroSCADA X SYS600 . Perform backend development using SCIL (Supervisory Control Implementation Language) . Perform frontend development using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript . Implement architectural design principles for scalable and resilient systems. Apply software craftsmanship principles including SOLID, DRY, KISS, and YAGNI . Develop functionalities supporting: Monitoring of production assets and available capacities. Information exchanges between TSOs and SCADA systems. Real-time calculation and transmission of operational setpoints. Power balancing mechanisms and reserve services integration. Work with version control and CI/CD processes using GitHub . Troubleshoot incidents and provide rapid corrective actions when required. Deliver sustainable long-term fixes following temporary workarounds. Participate in operational support activities for systems running 24/7. Collaborate with business representatives, analysts, architects, dispatchers, and technical teams. Follow training on SYS600 SCIL Programming Basics at the start of the assignment. Apply cybersecurity best practices within industrial environments and support compliance with NIS2 requirements. Participate in occasional site visits and short business trips when required. You have the following skills: Education & Experience Master’s degree in IT, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electromechanics, or related fields. Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience . SCADA & Industrial Systems SCADA systems development and maintenance. Understanding of industrial control systems. Knowledge of electricity production and power grid transmission fundamentals. Understanding of critical 24/7 operational environments. Software Development SCIL programming (or willingness to be trained rapidly). HTML5. CSS3. JavaScript. TypeScript. Backend and frontend development. Software architecture and design patterns. Version control using GitHub. CI/CD implementation. Software Engineering Practices SOLID principles. DRY principle. KISS principle. YAGNI principle. Clean code. Maintainable code. Resilient software design. Scalable solution design. Cybersecurity Awareness of cybersecurity principles in ICS environments. Awareness of cybersecurity principles in OT environments. Understanding of NIS2-related requirements. Methodologies Agile. SAFe®. Soft Skills Proactive and structured approach. Strong sense of ownership and responsibility. Solution-oriented mindset. Ability to work under pressure in critical operational environments. Rapid problem-solving capabilities. Continuous learning mindset. Initiative-taking attitude. Team-player attitude. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to collaborate in complex project organizations. Additional Requirements Willingness to participate in on-call support. Driving licence Hybrid working model with minimum 3 days/week onsite.

We are leaders in industrial, building, and production line automation in Greece, delivering advanced solutions for factories, energy facilities, infrastructure projects, and smart buildings. As a Siemens Solution Partner since 2009, we combine automation expertise with modern software technologies to help our customers optimize and digitalize their operations. The Role As an Industrial Software Engineer , you will design and develop HMI and SCADA applications for industrial automation projects, applying modern software engineering practices and object-oriented design principles. We welcome engineers with a strong software development background, regardless of previous experience with a specific SCADA platform. Experience in industrial applications is a plus, but solid programming skills, problem-solving ability, and a willingness to learn are equally valued. You will collaborate with automation engineers, project teams, and customers to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-friendly software solutions. The position is primarily office-based , with occasional presence at customers or project sites, mainly for commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, or project support. best practices Develop application functionality, interfaces, scripts, and software components Integrate applications with PLCs, databases, and external systems Participate in software architecture, review_candidates.title: Full Stack Engineer
review_candidates.description: 🚀 Full Stack Engineer – Munich 📍Munich | 💰 €60,000 - €90,000 | 🌍 Remote An established technology organisation in Munich is seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer to join its growing engineering team. Working across modern backend and frontend technologies, the company is building and scaling digital products with a strong focus on clean architecture, technical quality and modern development practices. They are searching for a skilled Full Stack Engineer passionate about: ⚙️ Tech: Node.js, TypeScript, PHP, Vue.js, Vue 3, Nuxt, Symfony, NestJS, REST APIs, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, AI Coding Agents, LLMs, JavaScript, Full Stack Development, Software Engineering. About the Role: As a Full Stack Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and developing modern applications across the entire technology stack, taking ownership of features from initial concept through to production. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a Full Stack Engineer to work across Node.js, PHP, TypeScript, Vue.js and Nuxt, contribute to architectural decisions and help shape the continued development of a modern technology platform. The role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership and working across both backend and frontend development. ➕ Nice to Have: Experience with Symfony and/or NestJS. Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms. Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines. Experience using AI coding agents or LLM-powered development tools. Strong understanding of clean code, design patterns and maintainable architecture. German language skills at B2 level or above. 💪 Benefits: Remote and flexible working options available. End-to-end ownership across frontend and backend development. Influence over architecture and technology decisions. Professional development and training opportunities. Opportunity to work with AI-assisted development tooling. Modern engineering environment with a strong focus on technical quality. ✉️ Due to the high number of applications, we may not be able to respond to everyone, but we truly appreciate the time and effort taken to apply and will be in touch with shortlisted candidates.
